import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
mkdirSync("src/app/api/households/dissolve", { recursive: true });
writeFileSync("postgres/migrations/016_add_household_dissolution.sql", `alter table households
  add column if not exists status text not null default 'active',
  add column if not exists dissolved_at timestamptz;

alter table households drop constraint if exists households_status;
alter table households add constraint households_status
  check (status in ('active', 'dissolving', 'dissolved', 'archived'));

create or replace function dissolve_current_household(dissolution_reason text)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := app_current_user_id();
  current_member household_members%rowtype;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select hm.* into current_member
  from household_members hm
  join households h on h.id = hm.household_id
  where hm.user_id = current_user_id and hm.role = 'owner' and h.status = 'active'
  order by hm.created_at asc
  limit 1
  for update of h, hm;

  if current_member.id is null then
    raise exception 'owner_permission_required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update households
  set status = 'dissolved', dissolved_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where id = current_member.household_id;

  update household_invitations
  set revoked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where household_id = current_member.household_id and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null;

  insert into household_lifecycle_events (household_id, actor_user_id, action, reason)
  values (current_member.household_id, current_member.user_id, 'household_dissolved', nullif(trim(dissolution_reason), ''));

  return current_member.household_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function dissolve_current_household(text) from public;
grant execute on function dissolve_current_household(text) to kakeibo_app;
`);
writeFileSync("supabase/migrations/202606060003_add_household_dissolution.sql", `alter table public.households
  add column if not exists status text not null default 'active',
  add column if not exists dissolved_at timestamptz;

alter table public.households drop constraint if exists households_status;
alter table public.households add constraint households_status
  check (status in ('active', 'dissolving', 'dissolved', 'archived'));

create or replace function public.dissolve_current_household(dissolution_reason text)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := public.app_current_user_id();
  current_member public.household_members%rowtype;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select hm.* into current_member
  from public.household_members hm
  join public.households h on h.id = hm.household_id
  where hm.user_id = current_user_id and hm.role = 'owner' and h.status = 'active'
  order by hm.created_at asc
  limit 1
  for update of h, hm;

  if current_member.id is null then
    raise exception 'owner_permission_required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update public.households
  set status = 'dissolved', dissolved_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where id = current_member.household_id;

  update public.household_invitations
  set revoked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where household_id = current_member.household_id and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null;

  insert into public.household_lifecycle_events (household_id, actor_user_id, action, reason)
  values (current_member.household_id, current_member.user_id, 'household_dissolved', nullif(trim(dissolution_reason), ''));

  return current_member.household_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.dissolve_current_household(text) from public;
grant execute on function public.dissolve_current_household(text) to authenticated;
`);
writeFileSync("src/app/api/households/dissolve/route.ts", `import { NextResponse } from "next/server.js";
import { z } from "zod";

import { db } from "../../../../lib/db.ts";
import { isUnauthenticatedRequest, resolveHouseholdContext } from "../../../../lib/household-context.ts";
import { canPerformHouseholdAction } from "../../../../lib/household-permissions.ts";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const dissolutionSchema = z.object({ reason: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200) });

function hasPgCode(error: unknown, code: string) {
  return typeof error === "object" && error != null && "code" in error && error.code === code;
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (await isUnauthenticatedRequest(request)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const parsed = dissolutionSchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_household_dissolution" }, { status: 400 });

    const pool = db();
    const context = await resolveHouseholdContext(pool, request);
    if (!context) return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
    if (!canPerformHouseholdAction({ role: context.role, action: "dissolve_household", actorMemberId: context.memberId })) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    if (context.householdStatus !== "active") return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_not_active" }, { status: 409 });

    const household = (await pool.query<{ household_id: string }>(
      "select dissolve_current_household($1)::text as household_id",
      [parsed.data.reason],
    )).rows[0];
    console.info("Dissolved household", { householdId: household.household_id });
    return NextResponse.json({ householdId: household.household_id, status: "dissolved" });
  } catch (error) {
    if (hasPgCode(error, "42501")) return NextResponse.json({ error: "forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    console.error("Failed to dissolve household", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_dissolution_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
`);

import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs";
const local = `
create or replace function transfer_household_owner(target_member_id uuid)
returns table (previous_owner_member_id uuid, new_owner_member_id uuid)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := app_current_user_id();
  current_member household_members%rowtype;
  target_member household_members%rowtype;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  select hm.* into current_member
  from household_members hm join households h on h.id = hm.household_id
  where hm.user_id = current_user_id and hm.role = 'owner' and h.status = 'active'
  order by hm.created_at asc limit 1 for update of h, hm;
  if current_member.id is null then raise exception 'owner_permission_required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  select hm.* into target_member from household_members hm
  where hm.id = target_member_id and hm.household_id = current_member.household_id and hm.role = 'partner'
  for update;
  if target_member.id is null then raise exception 'household_member_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  update household_members set role = 'partner', updated_at = now() where id = current_member.id;
  update household_members set role = 'owner', updated_at = now() where id = target_member.id;
  insert into household_lifecycle_events (household_id, actor_user_id, target_user_id, action)
  values (current_member.household_id, current_member.user_id, target_member.user_id, 'owner_transferred');
  return query select current_member.id, target_member.id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function accept_household_invitation(invitation_token_hash text, member_display_name text)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := app_current_user_id();
  invitation household_invitations%rowtype;
  created_member_id uuid;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  select hi.* into invitation
  from household_invitations hi join households h on h.id = hi.household_id
  where hi.token_hash = invitation_token_hash and hi.accepted_at is null and hi.revoked_at is null
    and hi.expires_at > now() and h.status = 'active'
  for update of hi, h;
  if invitation.id is null then raise exception 'household_invitation_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  insert into household_members (household_id, user_id, display_name, role)
  values (invitation.household_id, current_user_id, member_display_name, 'partner')
  on conflict (household_id, user_id) do nothing returning id into created_member_id;
  if created_member_id is null then raise exception 'household_member_already_exists' using errcode = '23505'; end if;
  update household_invitations set accepted_by_user_id = current_user_id, accepted_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where id = invitation.id;
  return created_member_id;
end;
$$;
`;
const supabase = local
  .replaceAll("app_current_user_id()", "public.app_current_user_id()")
  .replaceAll(" household_members", " public.household_members")
  .replaceAll(" households", " public.households")
  .replaceAll(" household_lifecycle_events", " public.household_lifecycle_events")
  .replaceAll(" household_invitations", " public.household_invitations")
  .replaceAll("function transfer_household_owner", "function public.transfer_household_owner")
  .replaceAll("function accept_household_invitation", "function public.accept_household_invitation");
appendFileSync("postgres/migrations/016_add_household_dissolution.sql", local);
appendFileSync("supabase/migrations/202606060003_add_household_dissolution.sql", supabase);

    '  const [currentHouseholdRole, setCurrentHouseholdRole] = useState<"owner" | "partner" | null>(null);\n  const [householdStatus, setHouseholdStatus] = useState<"active" | "dissolved" | null>(null);\n  const [householdDissolutionMessage, setHouseholdDissolutionMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [isHouseholdDissolutionPending, setIsHouseholdDissolutionPending] = useState(false);',
  );
  source = source.replace(
    '  const isComposerDisabled = !isCurrentPeriod || isDashboardLoading || isPeriodLocked;',
    '  const isHouseholdActive = householdStatus !== "dissolved";\n  const isComposerDisabled = !isCurrentPeriod || isDashboardLoading || isPeriodLocked || !isHouseholdActive;',
  );
  source = source.replace(
    'Promise<{ members: HouseholdMemberSettings[]; reminders: PaydayReminder[]; currentMemberId: string; currentRole: "owner" | "partner" }>',
    'Promise<{ members: HouseholdMemberSettings[]; reminders: PaydayReminder[]; currentMemberId: string; currentRole: "owner" | "partner"; householdStatus: "active" | "dissolved" }>',
  );
  source = source.replace(
    'setCurrentHouseholdId(data.currentMemberId); setCurrentHouseholdRole(data.currentRole);',
    'setCurrentHouseholdId(data.currentMemberId); setCurrentHouseholdRole(data.currentRole); setHouseholdStatus(data.householdStatus);',
  ).replaceAll("setCurrentHouseholdId", "setCurrentHouseholdMemberId");
  const functionMarker = "  const updateMemberPayday = async (memberId: string) => {";
  const dissolutionFunction = `  const dissolveHousehold = async () => {
    const reason = window.prompt("世帯を解消する理由を入力してください。解消後は過去履歴の閲覧のみになります。");
    if (!reason?.trim()) return;

    setHouseholdDissolutionMessage(null);
    setIsHouseholdDissolutionPending(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/households/dissolve", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason.trim() }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("household_dissolution_failed");
      setHouseholdStatus("dissolved");
      setHouseholdDissolutionMessage("世帯を解消しました。過去の履歴は引き続き確認できます。");
    } catch {
      setHouseholdDissolutionMessage("世帯を解消できませんでした。時間をおいて、もう一度お試しください。");
    } finally {
      setIsHouseholdDissolutionPending(false);
    }
  };

`;
  source = source.replace(functionMarker, dissolutionFunction + functionMarker);
  source = source.replace(
    '{currentHouseholdRole === "owner" ? (\n          <article className="panel settings-panel invitation-settings">',
    '{currentHouseholdRole === "owner" && householdStatus === "active" ? (\n          <article className="panel settings-panel invitation-settings">',
  );
  source = source.replace(
    '{currentHouseholdRole === "owner" ? (\n            <div className="shared-wallet-settings__grid">',
    '{currentHouseholdRole === "owner" && householdStatus === "active" ? (\n            <div className="shared-wallet-settings__grid">',
  );
  source = source.replace(
    ') : currentHouseholdRole === "partner" ? <p className="recurring-empty">現在のownerだけが移譲できます。</p> : <p className="recurring-empty">読み込み中...</p>}',
    ') : householdStatus === "dissolved" ? <p className="recurring-empty">解消済みのためowner移譲はできません。</p> : currentHouseholdRole === "partner" ? <p className="recurring-empty">現在のownerだけが移譲できます。</p> : <p className="recurring-empty">読み込み中...</p>}',
  );
  const panelMarker = '        <article className="panel settings-panel payday-settings">';
  const dissolutionPanel = `        <article className="panel settings-panel household-dissolution-settings" aria-label="世帯の解消">
          <h3>世帯の解消</h3>
          <p className="recurring-empty">解消後は支出や精算を更新できなくなります。過去の履歴は残ります。</p>
          {householdStatus === "dissolved" ? (
            <p className="recurring-empty">この世帯は解消済みです。現在は閲覧のみ利用できます。</p>
          ) : currentHouseholdRole === "owner" ? (
            <button className="chip chip--danger" type="button" disabled={isHouseholdDissolutionPending} onClick={() => void dissolveHousehold()}>
              {isHouseholdDissolutionPending ? "解消中..." : "世帯を解消する"}
            </button>
          ) : <p className="recurring-empty">世帯の解消はownerだけが実行できます。</p>}
          {householdDissolutionMessage ? <p className="recurring-empty" role="status">{householdDissolutionMessage}</p> : null}
        </article>
`;
  source = source.replace(panelMarker, dissolutionPanel + panelMarker);
  writeFileSync(path, source);
}

    const invitationRoute = await import("../../src/app/api/household-invitations/route.ts");
    const dissolutionRoute = await import("../../src/app/api/households/dissolve/route.ts");
    const dashboardRoute = await import("../../src/app/api/dashboard/route.ts");
    const expenseRoute = await import("../../src/app/api/expenses/route.ts");
    const householdId = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa";

    const invitationResponse = await invitationRoute.POST(new Request("http://localhost/api/household-invitations", {

    }));
    assert.equal(invitationResponse.status, 201);
    const invitationId = (await invitationResponse.json()).invitation.id;

    const partnerAttempt = await dissolutionRoute.POST(new Request("http://localhost/api/households/dissolve", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "x-kakeibo-user-id": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reason: "partnerからの実行" }),
    }));
    assert.equal(partnerAttempt.status, 403);

    try {
      const dissolved = await dissolutionRoute.POST(new Request("http://localhost/api/households/dissolve", {
        method: "POST",

        body: JSON.stringify({ reason: "統合テストのため解消" }),
      }));

      assert.deepEqual(await dissolved.json(), { householdId, status: "dissolved" });

      assert.deepEqual((await pool.query<{ status: string }>(
        "select status from household_invitations where id = $1",

      )).rows, [{ status: "revoked" }]);
      assert.deepEqual((await pool.query<{ action: string; reason: string }>(
        "select action, reason from household_lifecycle_events where household_id = $1 order by created_at desc limit 1",
        [householdId],

      const dashboard = await dashboardRoute.GET(new Request(\`http://localhost/api/dashboard?year=\${testPeriod.year}&month=\${testPeriod.month}\`));

        body: JSON.stringify({ reason: "再実行" }),
      }));

      await pool.query("delete from household_lifecycle_events where household_id = $1 and action = 'household_dissolved'", [householdId]);

    }
  });

`;

*** Add File: middleware.ts
+import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
+import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
+
+function isAuthRequired() {
+  if (process.env.KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE) return process.env.KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE === "required";
+  return process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";
+}
+
+export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
+  if (!isAuthRequired()) return NextResponse.next();
+
+  const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
+  const publishableKey = process.env.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
+  if (!url || !publishableKey) return NextResponse.next();
+
+  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
+  const supabase = createServerClient(url, publishableKey, {
+    cookies: {
+      getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
+      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
+        for (const { name, value } of cookiesToSet) request.cookies.set(name, value);
+        response = NextResponse.next({ request });
+        for (const { name, value, options } of cookiesToSet) response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
+      },
+    },
+  });
+
+  const { data: claimsData } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();
+  const { data: sessionData } = claimsData.claims ? await supabase.auth.getSession() : { data: { session: null } };
+  if (sessionData.session?.access_token && !request.headers.has("authorization")) {
+    const headers = new Headers(request.headers);
+    headers.set("authorization", `Bearer ${sessionData.session.access_token}`);
+    response = NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } });
+  }
+
+  const isApi = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/api/");
+  const isLogin = request.nextUrl.pathname === "/login";
+  if (!claimsData.claims && !isApi && !isLogin) {
+    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/login", request.url));
+  }
+  if (claimsData.claims && isLogin) {
+    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/", request.url));
+  }
+
+  return response;
+}
+
+export const config = {
+  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|manifest.webmanifest).*)"],
+};

 ### 3.2. パスワード保存方針
 
 - 本番のパスワード認証は Supabase Auth に委譲する。
+- 登録、ログイン、ログアウトは `@supabase/ssr` のCookieセッションを利用し、middlewareで期限切れ前後のセッションを更新する。
+- APIへはmiddlewareが有効なSupabase access tokenを `Authorization: Bearer` として引き渡し、既存のJWT検証を必ず通す。

'src/app/login/actions.ts': `"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { parseAuthCredentials } from "../../lib/auth-credentials.ts";
import { createSupabaseServerClient } from "../../lib/supabase/server.ts";

export type AuthActionState = {
  error?: string;
  message?: string;
};

function authErrorMessage() {
  return "メールアドレスまたはパスワードを確認してください。";
}

export async function signIn(_state: AuthActionState, formData: FormData): Promise<AuthActionState> {
  const parsed = parseAuthCredentials(formData);
  if (!parsed.success) return { error: "メールアドレスと8文字以上のパスワードを入力してください。" };

  try {
    const supabase = await createSupabaseServerClient();
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(parsed.data);
    if (error) return { error: authErrorMessage() };
  } catch {
    return { error: "認証サービスへ接続できませんでした。時間をおいて再度お試しください。" };
  }

  redirect("/");
}

export async function signUp(_state: AuthActionState, formData: FormData): Promise<AuthActionState> {
  const parsed = parseAuthCredentials(formData);
  if (!parsed.success) return { error: "メールアドレスと8文字以上のパスワードを入力してください。" };

  try {
    const supabase = await createSupabaseServerClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp(parsed.data);
    if (error) return { error: authErrorMessage() };
    if (!data.session) return { message: "確認メールを送信しました。メール内のリンクから登録を完了してください。" };
  } catch {
    return { error: "認証サービスへ接続できませんでした。時間をおいて再度お試しください。" };
  }

  redirect("/");
}

export async function signOut() {
  try {
    const supabase = await createSupabaseServerClient();
    await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: "local" });
  } finally {
    redirect("/login");
  }
}
`,

'middleware.ts': `import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

function isAuthRequired() {
  if (process.env.KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE) return process.env.KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE === "required";
  return process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";
}

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!isAuthRequired()) return NextResponse.next();

  const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  const publishableKey = process.env.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;
  if (!url || !publishableKey) return NextResponse.next();

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const supabase = createServerClient(url, publishableKey, {
    cookies: {
      getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
      setAll(cookiesToSet) {
        for (const { name, value } of cookiesToSet) request.cookies.set(name, value);
        response = NextResponse.next({ request });
        for (const { name, value, options } of cookiesToSet) response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
      },
    },
  });

  const { data: claimsData } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();
  const { data: sessionData } = claimsData.claims ? await supabase.auth.getSession() : { data: { session: null } };
  if (sessionData.session?.access_token && !request.headers.has("authorization")) {
    const headers = new Headers(request.headers);
    headers.set("authorization", \`Bearer \${sessionData.session.access_token}\`);
    response = NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } });
  }

  const isApi = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith("/api/");
  const isLogin = request.nextUrl.pathname === "/login";
  if (!claimsData.claims && !isApi && !isLogin) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/login", request.url));
  if (claimsData.claims && isLogin) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/", request.url));

  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|manifest.webmanifest).*)"],
};
`,

const callback = `import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { createSupabaseServerClient } from "../../../lib/supabase/server.ts";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function safeNextPath(value: string | null) {
  return value?.startsWith("/") && !value.startsWith("//") ? value : "/";
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
  const next = safeNextPath(url.searchParams.get("next"));

  if (code) {
    const supabase = await createSupabaseServerClient();
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
    if (!error) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(next, url.origin));
  }

  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/login?error=confirmation_failed", url.origin));
}
`;

};

    KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE: originalEnv.authMode,
    SUPABASE_URL: originalEnv.supabaseUrl,
    SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: originalEnv.publishableKey,
  })) {

    else process.env[name] = value;
  }
});

    process.env.KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE = "required";
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:3999";
    process.env.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = "test-key";

    const response = await middleware(new NextRequest("http://localhost/"));

    assert.equal(response.status, 307);
    assert.equal(response.headers.get("location"), "http://localhost/login");
  });

    process.env.KAKEIBO_AUTH_MODE = "required";
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:3999";
    process.env.SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = "test-key";

  });

    assert.equal(response.headers.get("x-middleware-next"), "1");
  });
});
`);

const fs = require('fs');
const local = `create or replace function create_current_user_household(household_name text, member_display_name text)
returns table (household_id uuid, member_id uuid)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := app_current_user_id();
  created_household_id uuid;
  created_member_id uuid;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(current_user_id::text, 0));
  if not exists (select 1 from app_users where id = current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'user_not_found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from household_members where user_id = current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'household_member_already_exists' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  insert into households (name, default_split_type, status)
  values (trim(household_name), 'equal', 'active')
  returning id into created_household_id;

  insert into household_members (household_id, user_id, display_name, role, default_share_rate)
  values (created_household_id, current_user_id, trim(member_display_name), 'owner', 1)
  returning id into created_member_id;

  insert into payment_sources (household_id, name, type, owner_member_id)
  values
    (created_household_id, '共通財布', 'shared_wallet', null),
    (created_household_id, trim(member_display_name) || 'の支払い', 'member_personal', created_member_id);

  insert into categories (household_id, name, kind, default_expense_scope, default_split_type)
  values
    (created_household_id, '家賃', 'rent', 'shared', 'equal'),
    (created_household_id, '食費', 'food', 'shared', 'equal'),
    (created_household_id, '日用品', 'daily_goods', 'shared', 'equal'),
    (created_household_id, '外食', 'eating_out', 'review', 'equal'),
    (created_household_id, 'サブスク', 'subscription', 'shared', 'equal');

  return query select created_household_id, created_member_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function create_current_user_household(text, text) from public;
grant execute on function create_current_user_household(text, text) to kakeibo_app;

create or replace function accept_household_invitation(invitation_token_hash text, member_display_name text)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := app_current_user_id();
  invitation household_invitations%rowtype;
  created_member_id uuid;
begin
  if current_user_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(current_user_id::text, 0));
  if exists (select 1 from household_members where user_id = current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'household_member_already_exists' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;
  select hi.* into invitation
  from household_invitations hi join households h on h.id = hi.household_id
  where hi.token_hash = invitation_token_hash and hi.accepted_at is null and hi.revoked_at is null
    and hi.expires_at > now() and h.status = 'active'
  for update of hi, h;
  if invitation.id is null then raise exception 'household_invitation_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  insert into household_members (household_id, user_id, display_name, role, default_share_rate)
  values (invitation.household_id, current_user_id, trim(member_display_name), 'partner', 0.5)
  returning id into created_member_id;
  update household_members set default_share_rate = 0.5 where household_id = invitation.household_id;
  insert into payment_sources (household_id, name, type, owner_member_id)
  values (invitation.household_id, trim(member_display_name) || 'の支払い', 'member_personal', created_member_id);
  update household_invitations set accepted_by_user_id = current_user_id, accepted_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where id = invitation.id;
  return created_member_id;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function accept_household_invitation(text, text) from public;
grant execute on function accept_household_invitation(text, text) to kakeibo_app;
`;
const supabase = local
  .replaceAll('app_current_user_id()', 'public.app_current_user_id()')
  .replaceAll('app_users', 'auth.users')
  .replaceAll('household_members', 'public.household_members')
  .replaceAll('household_invitations', 'public.household_invitations')
  .replaceAll('households', 'public.households')
  .replaceAll('payment_sources', 'public.payment_sources')
  .replaceAll('categories', 'public.categories')
  .replaceAll('create_current_user_household', 'public.create_current_user_household')
  .replaceAll('accept_household_invitation', 'public.accept_household_invitation')
  .replaceAll('to kakeibo_app', 'to authenticated');
fs.writeFileSync('postgres/migrations/017_add_household_onboarding.sql', local);
fs.writeFileSync('supabase/migrations/202606070001_add_household_onboarding.sql', supabase);

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const files = {
'src/lib/current-household-server.ts': `import { headers } from "next/headers.js";

import { db } from "./db.ts";
import { resolveHouseholdContext } from "./household-context.ts";

export async function currentHouseholdContext() {
  const requestHeaders = await headers();
  return resolveHouseholdContext(db(), new Request("http://kakeibo.internal", { headers: requestHeaders }));
}
`,
'src/app/api/households/route.ts': `import { NextResponse } from "next/server.js";
import { z } from "zod";

import { db } from "../../../lib/db.ts";
import { isUnauthenticatedRequest, resolveHouseholdContext } from "../../../lib/household-context.ts";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const createHouseholdSchema = z.object({
  householdName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80),
  displayName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(50),
});

function hasPgCode(error: unknown, code: string) {
  return typeof error === "object" && error != null && "code" in error && error.code === code;
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (await isUnauthenticatedRequest(request)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const parsed = createHouseholdSchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_household" }, { status: 400 });

    const pool = db();
    if (await resolveHouseholdContext(pool, request)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_member_already_exists" }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const created = (await pool.query<{ household_id: string; member_id: string }>(
      "select household_id::text, member_id::text from create_current_user_household($1, $2)",
      [parsed.data.householdName, parsed.data.displayName],
    )).rows[0];

    return NextResponse.json({ householdId: created.household_id, memberId: created.member_id }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    if (hasPgCode(error, "23505")) return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_member_already_exists" }, { status: 409 });
    if (hasPgCode(error, "23503")) return NextResponse.json({ error: "user_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
    console.error("Failed to create household", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_create_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
`,
'src/app/onboarding/onboarding-form.tsx': `"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

+type Mode = "create" | "join";
+
+export function OnboardingForm() {
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("create");
+  const [householdName, setHouseholdName] = useState("");
+  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
+  const [invitationToken, setInvitationToken] = useState("");
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
+
+  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    setMessage(null);
+    setPending(true);
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch(mode === "create" ? "/api/households" : "/api/household-invitations/accept", {
+        method: "POST",
+        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
+        body: JSON.stringify(mode === "create"
+          ? { householdName, displayName }
+          : { token: invitationToken.trim(), displayName }),
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) {
+        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: string };
+        if (body.error === "household_member_already_exists") window.location.assign("/");
+        else if (body.error === "household_invitation_not_found") setMessage("招待コードが無効か、期限切れです。");
+        else setMessage(mode === "create" ? "世帯を作成できませんでした。" : "世帯へ参加できませんでした。");
+        return;
+      }
+      window.location.assign("/");
+    } catch {
+      setMessage("通信状態を確認して、もう一度お試しください。");
+    } finally {
+      setPending(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <>
+      <div className="onboarding-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="利用開始方法">
+        <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={mode === "create"} onClick={() => { setMode("create"); setMessage(null); }}>新しい世帯を作る</button>
+        <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={mode === "join"} onClick={() => { setMode("join"); setMessage(null); }}>招待コードで参加</button>
+      </div>
+      <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submit}>
+        {mode === "create" ? (
+          <label>
+            世帯名
+            <input value={householdName} onChange={(event) => setHouseholdName(event.target.value)} maxLength={80} placeholder="例: ふたり暮らし" required />
+          </label>
+        ) : (
+          <label>
+            招待コード
+            <input value={invitationToken} onChange={(event) => setInvitationToken(event.target.value)} minLength={40} maxLength={200} autoComplete="off" required />
+          </label>
+        )}
+        <label>
+          あなたの表示名
+          <input value={displayName} onChange={(event) => setDisplayName(event.target.value)} maxLength={50} placeholder="例: 葵" required />
+        </label>
+        {message ? <p className="auth-form__error" role="alert">{message}</p> : null}
+        <button className="auth-form__submit" type="submit" disabled={pending}>
+          {pending ? "設定中..." : mode === "create" ? "世帯を作成して始める" : "世帯へ参加する"}
+        </button>
+      </form>
+    </>
+  );
+}
`.replace(/^\+/gm, ''),

node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const postgres = `create or replace function preview_household_invitation(invitation_token_hash text)
returns table (household_name text, invited_by text, expires_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := app_current_user_id();
begin
  if current_user_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from household_members where user_id = current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'household_member_already_exists' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  return query
  select h.name, hm.display_name, hi.expires_at
  from household_invitations hi
  join households h on h.id = hi.household_id
  join household_members hm on hm.id = hi.invited_by_member_id
  where hi.token_hash = invitation_token_hash
    and hi.accepted_at is null
    and hi.revoked_at is null
    and hi.expires_at > now()
    and h.status = 'active';

  if not found then raise exception 'household_invitation_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function preview_household_invitation(text) from public;
grant execute on function preview_household_invitation(text) to kakeibo_app;
`;
const supabase = `create or replace function public.preview_household_invitation(invitation_token_hash text)
returns table (household_name text, invited_by text, expires_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  current_user_id uuid := public.app_current_user_id();
begin
  if current_user_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.household_members where user_id = current_user_id) then
    raise exception 'household_member_already_exists' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  return query
  select h.name, hm.display_name, hi.expires_at
  from public.household_invitations hi
  join public.households h on h.id = hi.household_id
  join public.household_members hm on hm.id = hi.invited_by_member_id
  where hi.token_hash = invitation_token_hash
    and hi.accepted_at is null
    and hi.revoked_at is null
    and hi.expires_at > now()
    and h.status = 'active';

  if not found then raise exception 'household_invitation_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.preview_household_invitation(text) from public;
grant execute on function public.preview_household_invitation(text) to authenticated;
`;
fs.writeFileSync('postgres/migrations/018_add_household_invitation_preview.sql', postgres);
fs.writeFileSync('supabase/migrations/202606070002_add_household_invitation_preview.sql', supabase);

node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const content = `import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

import { NextResponse } from "next/server.js";
import { z } from "zod";
import { db } from "../../../../lib/db.ts";
import { isUnauthenticatedRequest } from "../../../../lib/household-context.ts";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const tokenSchema = z.string().min(40).max(200);
const acceptSchema = z.object({
  token: tokenSchema,
  displayName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(50),
});

function hashInvitationToken(token: string) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");
}

function hasPgCode(error: unknown, code: string) {
  return typeof error === "object" && error != null && "code" in error && (error as { code: unknown }).code === code;
}

function invitationErrorResponse(error: unknown) {
  if (hasPgCode(error, "P0002")) return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_invitation_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
  if (hasPgCode(error, "23505")) return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_member_already_exists" }, { status: 409 });
  return null;
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  if (await isUnauthenticatedRequest(request)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });
  try {
    const parsed = tokenSchema.safeParse(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("token"));
    if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_household_invitation_preview" }, { status: 400 });

    const invitation = (await db().query<{ household_name: string; invited_by: string; expires_at: string }>(
      "select household_name, invited_by, expires_at::text from preview_household_invitation($1)",
      [hashInvitationToken(parsed.data)],
    )).rows[0];
    if (!invitation) return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_invitation_not_found" }, { status: 404 });

    return NextResponse.json({ invitation });
  } catch (error) {
    const response = invitationErrorResponse(error);
    if (response) return response;
    console.error("Failed to preview household invitation", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_invitation_preview_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (await isUnauthenticatedRequest(request)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });
  try {
    const parsed = acceptSchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_household_invitation_accept" }, { status: 400 });

    const member = (await db().query<{ member_id: string }>(
      "select accept_household_invitation($1, $2)::text as member_id",
      [hashInvitationToken(parsed.data.token), parsed.data.displayName],
    )).rows[0];
    if (!member) return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_invitation_not_found" }, { status: 404 });

    console.info("Accepted household invitation", { memberId: member.member_id });
    return NextResponse.json({ memberId: member.member_id }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    const response = invitationErrorResponse(error);
    if (response) return response;
    if (hasPgCode(error, "23503")) return NextResponse.json({ error: "invitation_user_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
    console.error("Failed to accept household invitation", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_invitation_accept_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
`;
fs.writeFileSync('src/app/api/household-invitations/accept/route.ts', content);

const fs = require('fs');
const content = `"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

type Mode = "create" | "join";
type InvitationPreview = { household_name: string; invited_by: string; expires_at: string };

export function OnboardingForm() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("create");
  const [householdName, setHouseholdName] = useState("");
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
  const [invitationToken, setInvitationToken] = useState("");
  const [invitationPreview, setInvitationPreview] = useState<InvitationPreview | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const changeMode = (nextMode: Mode) => {
    setMode(nextMode);
    setInvitationPreview(null);
    setMessage(null);
  };

  const handleResponseError = async (response: Response, fallback: string) => {
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: string };
    if (body.error === "household_member_already_exists") window.location.assign("/");
    else if (body.error === "household_invitation_not_found") setMessage("招待コードが無効か、期限切れです。送信者へ確認してください。");
    else setMessage(fallback);
  };

  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setMessage(null);
    setPending(true);
    try {
      if (mode === "join" && !invitationPreview) {
        const response = await fetch(\`/api/household-invitations/accept?token=\${encodeURIComponent(invitationToken.trim())}\`);
        if (!response.ok) {
          await handleResponseError(response, "招待内容を確認できませんでした。");
          return;
        }
        const body = await response.json() as { invitation: InvitationPreview };
        setInvitationPreview(body.invitation);
        return;
      }

      const response = await fetch(mode === "create" ? "/api/households" : "/api/household-invitations/accept", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(mode === "create"
          ? { householdName, displayName }
          : { token: invitationToken.trim(), displayName }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        await handleResponseError(response, mode === "create" ? "世帯を作成できませんでした。" : "世帯へ参加できませんでした。");
        return;
      }
      window.location.assign("/");
    } catch {
      setMessage("通信状態を確認して、もう一度お試しください。");
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="onboarding-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="利用開始方法">
        <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={mode === "create"} onClick={() => changeMode("create")}>新しい世帯を作る</button>
        <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={mode === "join"} onClick={() => changeMode("join")}>招待コードで参加</button>
      </div>
      <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submit}>
        {mode === "create" ? (
          <label>
            世帯名
            <input value={householdName} onChange={(event) => setHouseholdName(event.target.value)} maxLength={80} placeholder="例: ふたり暮らし" required />
          </label>
        ) : (
          <label>
            招待コード
            <input value={invitationToken} onChange={(event) => { setInvitationToken(event.target.value); setInvitationPreview(null); }} minLength={40} maxLength={200} autoComplete="off" readOnly={invitationPreview != null} required />
          </label>
        )}
        <label>
          あなたの表示名
          <input value={displayName} onChange={(event) => setDisplayName(event.target.value)} maxLength={50} placeholder="例: 葵" required />
        </label>
        {invitationPreview ? (
          <section className="onboarding-preview" aria-label="招待内容の確認">
            <span>参加先</span>
            <strong>{invitationPreview.household_name}</strong>
            <p>招待者 {invitationPreview.invited_by} ・ {new Date(invitationPreview.expires_at).toLocaleString("ja-JP")}まで</p>
            <p>心当たりのある世帯か確認してから参加してください。</p>
            <button className="auth-form__secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setInvitationPreview(null)} disabled={pending}>招待コードを変更</button>
          </section>
        ) : null}
        {message ? <p className="auth-form__error" role="alert">{message}</p> : null}
        <button className="auth-form__submit" type="submit" disabled={pending}>
          {pending ? "確認中..." : mode === "create" ? "世帯を作成して始める" : invitationPreview ? "この世帯に参加する" : "招待内容を確認する"}
        </button>
      </form>
    </>
  );
}
`;

const fs = require('fs');
fs.writeFileSync('src/lib/account-security.ts', `import { z } from "zod";

const passwordChangeSchema = z.object({
  currentPassword: z.string().min(8).max(72),
  newPassword: z.string().min(8).max(72),
  confirmPassword: z.string().min(8).max(72),
}).refine((value) => value.newPassword === value.confirmPassword, {
  message: "password_confirmation_mismatch",
  path: ["confirmPassword"],
}).refine((value) => value.currentPassword !== value.newPassword, {
  message: "password_unchanged",
  path: ["newPassword"],
});

export function parsePasswordChange(formData: FormData) {
  return passwordChangeSchema.safeParse({
    currentPassword: formData.get("currentPassword"),
    newPassword: formData.get("newPassword"),
    confirmPassword: formData.get("confirmPassword"),
  });
}
`);
fs.writeFileSync('src/app/account-security-actions.ts', `"use server";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { parsePasswordChange } from "../lib/account-security.ts";
import { createSupabaseServerClient } from "../lib/supabase/server.ts";

export type AccountSecurityActionState = { error?: string };

function connectionError(): AccountSecurityActionState {
  return { error: "認証サービスへ接続できませんでした。時間をおいて再度お試しください。" };
}

export async function changePassword(_state: AccountSecurityActionState, formData: FormData): Promise<AccountSecurityActionState> {
  const parsed = parsePasswordChange(formData);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const issue = parsed.error.issues[0]?.message;
    if (issue === "password_confirmation_mismatch") return { error: "新しいパスワードが一致しません。" };
    if (issue === "password_unchanged") return { error: "現在と異なるパスワードを入力してください。" };
    return { error: "現在のパスワードと8文字以上の新しいパスワードを入力してください。" };
  }

  try {
    const supabase = await createSupabaseServerClient();
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
      current_password: parsed.data.currentPassword,
      password: parsed.data.newPassword,
    });
    if (error) return { error: "現在のパスワードを確認してください。" };
    await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: "global" });
  } catch {
    return connectionError();
  }

  redirect("/login?security=password-changed");
}

export async function signOutAllSessions(_state: AccountSecurityActionState): Promise<AccountSecurityActionState> {
  try {
    const supabase = await createSupabaseServerClient();
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: "global" });
    if (error) return { error: "全端末からログアウトできませんでした。時間をおいて再度お試しください。" };
  } catch {
    return connectionError();
  }

  redirect("/login?security=signed-out-all");
}
`);
fs.writeFileSync('src/components/account-security-panel.tsx', `"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";

import { changePassword, signOutAllSessions, type AccountSecurityActionState } from "../app/account-security-actions";

const initialState: AccountSecurityActionState = {};

export function AccountSecurityPanel() {
  const [passwordState, passwordAction, passwordPending] = useActionState(changePassword, initialState);
  const [logoutState, logoutAction, logoutPending] = useActionState(signOutAllSessions, initialState);

  return (

const fs = require('fs');

  user_id uuid not null references app_users(id) on delete cascade,
  session_id uuid not null,
  user_agent text,
  first_seen_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  last_seen_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  expires_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  revoked_reason text,
  primary key (user_id, session_id)
);

create table if not exists auth_session_audit_logs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  actor_user_id uuid not null references app_users(id) on delete cascade,
  target_user_id uuid not null references app_users(id) on delete cascade,
  target_session_id uuid,
  action text not null check (action in ('session_revoked', 'all_sessions_revoked')),
  reason text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists auth_sessions_user_last_seen_idx on auth_sessions(user_id, last_seen_at desc);
create index if not exists auth_session_audit_user_created_idx on auth_session_audit_logs(target_user_id, created_at desc);

grant select, insert, update on auth_sessions to kakeibo_app;
grant select, insert on auth_session_audit_logs to kakeibo_app;

alter table auth_sessions enable row level security;
alter table auth_sessions force row level security;
drop policy if exists auth_sessions_self on auth_sessions;
create policy auth_sessions_self on auth_sessions for all to kakeibo_app
  using (user_id = app_current_user_id())
  with check (user_id = app_current_user_id());

alter table auth_session_audit_logs enable row level security;
alter table auth_session_audit_logs force row level security;
drop policy if exists auth_session_audit_logs_self on auth_session_audit_logs;
create policy auth_session_audit_logs_self on auth_session_audit_logs for all to kakeibo_app
  using (target_user_id = app_current_user_id())
  with check (actor_user_id = app_current_user_id() and target_user_id = app_current_user_id());
`;

node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const content = `import { Pool } from "pg";

export type VerifiedAuthSession = {
  userId: string;
  sessionId: string | null;
  issuedAt: number | null;
  expiresAt: number | null;
};

type SessionRow = {
  session_id: string;
  user_agent: string | null;
  first_seen_at: string;
  last_seen_at: string;
  expires_at: string | null;
  revoked_at: string | null;
};

let pool: Pool | null = null;

function appDatabaseUrl() {
  if (process.env.DATABASE_APP_URL) return process.env.DATABASE_APP_URL;
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) return null;
  const url = new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL);
  url.username = process.env.DATABASE_APP_USER ?? "kakeibo_app";
  url.password = process.env.DATABASE_APP_PASSWORD ?? "kakeibo_app_password";
  return url.toString();
}

function sessionPool() {
  const url = appDatabaseUrl();
  if (!url) return null;
  pool ??= new Pool({ connectionString: url });
  return pool;
}

async function withUser<T>(userId: string, callback: (client: import("pg").PoolClient) => Promise<T>) {
  const currentPool = sessionPool();
  if (!currentPool) return null;
  const client = await currentPool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query("select set_config('app.current_user_id', $1, false)", [userId]);
    return await callback(client);
  } finally {
    await client.query("reset app.current_user_id").catch(() => undefined);
    client.release();
  }
}

export async function registerAndValidateAuthSession(session: VerifiedAuthSession, userAgent: string | null) {
  if (!session.sessionId) return true;
  const result = await withUser(session.userId, async (client) => {
    const existing = (await client.query<{ revoked_at: string | null }>(
      "select revoked_at::text from auth_sessions where user_id = $1 and session_id = $2",
      [session.userId, session.sessionId],
    )).rows[0];
    if (existing?.revoked_at) return false;
    await client.query(\`
      insert into auth_sessions (user_id, session_id, user_agent, expires_at)
      values ($1, $2, $3, $4)
      on conflict (user_id, session_id) do update
      set user_agent = coalesce(excluded.user_agent, auth_sessions.user_agent),
          last_seen_at = now(),
          expires_at = excluded.expires_at
    \`, [session.userId, session.sessionId, userAgent?.slice(0, 500) ?? null, session.expiresAt ? new Date(session.expiresAt * 1000) : null]);
    return true;
  });
  return result ?? true;
}

export async function listAuthSessions(userId: string) {
  return await withUser(userId, async (client) => (await client.query<SessionRow>(\`
    select session_id::text, user_agent, first_seen_at::text, last_seen_at::text, expires_at::text, revoked_at::text
    from auth_sessions where user_id = $1 order by last_seen_at desc
  \`, [userId])).rows) ?? [];
}

export async function revokeAuthSession(userId: string, sessionId: string, reason: string) {
  return await withUser(userId, async (client) => {
    await client.query("begin");
    try {
      const updated = await client.query(
        "update auth_sessions set revoked_at = now(), revoked_reason = $3 where user_id = $1 and session_id = $2 and revoked_at is null",
        [userId, sessionId, reason],
      );
      if (!updated.rowCount) { await client.query("rollback"); return false; }
      await client.query(\`
        insert into auth_session_audit_logs (actor_user_id, target_user_id, target_session_id, action, reason)
        values ($1, $1, $2, 'session_revoked', $3)
      \`, [userId, sessionId, reason]);
      await client.query("commit");
      return true;
    } catch (error) { await client.query("rollback"); throw error; }
  }) ?? false;
}

export async function revokeAllAuthSessions(userId: string, reason: string) {
  return await withUser(userId, async (client) => {
    await client.query("begin");
    try {
      await client.query("update auth_sessions set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, now()), revoked_reason = coalesce(revoked_reason, $2) where user_id = $1", [userId, reason]);
      await client.query(\`
        insert into auth_session_audit_logs (actor_user_id, target_user_id, action, reason)
        values ($1, $1, 'all_sessions_revoked', $2)
      \`, [userId, reason]);
      await client.query("commit");
    } catch (error) { await client.query("rollback"); throw error; }
  });
}
`;
fs.writeFileSync('src/lib/auth-session-store.ts', content);

const fs = require('fs');
fs.writeFileSync('src/lib/request-auth-context.ts', `import { AsyncLocalStorage } from "node:async_hooks";

import type { VerifiedAuthSession } from "./auth-session-store.ts";

const requestAuthStorage = new AsyncLocalStorage<VerifiedAuthSession | null>();

export function setRequestAuthIdentity(identity: VerifiedAuthSession | null) {
  requestAuthStorage.enterWith(identity);
}

export function requestAuthIdentity() {
  return requestAuthStorage.getStore() ?? null;
}

export function requestAuthUserId() {
  return requestAuthIdentity()?.userId ?? null;
}
`);

const fs = require('fs');
fs.writeFileSync('src/app/api/auth-sessions/route.ts', `import { NextResponse } from "next/server.js";
import { z } from "zod";

import { listAuthSessions, revokeAuthSession } from "../../../lib/auth-session-store.ts";
import { authIdentityFromRequest, isUnauthenticatedRequest } from "../../../lib/household-context.ts";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const revokeSchema = z.object({ sessionId: z.string().uuid(), reason: z.literal("lost_device").default("lost_device") });

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  if (await isUnauthenticatedRequest(request)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });
  const identity = await authIdentityFromRequest(request);
  if (!identity) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });
  const sessions = await listAuthSessions(identity.userId);
  return NextResponse.json({
    sessions: sessions.map((session) => ({ ...session, current: session.session_id === identity.sessionId })),
  });
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  if (await isUnauthenticatedRequest(request)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });
  const identity = await authIdentityFromRequest(request);
  if (!identity) return NextResponse.json({ error: "unauthenticated" }, { status: 401 });
  const parsed = revokeSchema.safeParse(await request.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid_auth_session_action" }, { status: 400 });
  const revoked = await revokeAuthSession(identity.userId, parsed.data.sessionId, parsed.data.reason);
  if (!revoked) return NextResponse.json({ error: "auth_session_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
  return NextResponse.json({ sessionId: parsed.data.sessionId, revoked: true });
}
`);

const fs = require('fs');
fs.writeFileSync('src/components/account-security-panel.tsx', `"use client";

import { useActionState, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { changePassword, signOutAllSessions, type AccountSecurityActionState } from "../app/account-security-actions";

const initialState: AccountSecurityActionState = {};

type AuthSession = {
  session_id: string;
  user_agent: string | null;
  first_seen_at: string;
  last_seen_at: string;
  expires_at: string | null;
  revoked_at: string | null;
  current: boolean;
};

function deviceLabel(userAgent: string | null) {
  if (!userAgent) return "不明な端末";
  if (/iPhone|iPad/.test(userAgent)) return "iPhone / iPad";
  if (/Android/.test(userAgent)) return "Android";
  if (/Windows/.test(userAgent)) return "Windows";
  if (/Macintosh|Mac OS/.test(userAgent)) return "Mac";
  if (/Linux/.test(userAgent)) return "Linux";
  return "ブラウザ端末";
}

export function AccountSecurityPanel() {
  const [passwordState, passwordAction, passwordPending] = useActionState(changePassword, initialState);
  const [logoutState, logoutAction, logoutPending] = useActionState(signOutAllSessions, initialState);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<AuthSession[]>([]);
  const [sessionError, setSessionError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadSessions = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/auth-sessions");
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("load_failed");
      setSessions(((await response.json()) as { sessions: AuthSession[] }).sessions);
      setSessionError(null);
    } catch {
      setSessionError("ログイン端末を読み込めませんでした。");
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { void loadSessions(); }, []);

  const revokeSession = async (session: AuthSession) => {
    if (!window.confirm(deviceLabel(session.user_agent) + "のセッションを無効化します。続けますか？")) return;
    const response = await fetch("/api/auth-sessions", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: session.session_id, reason: "lost_device" }),
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      setSessionError("端末をログアウトできませんでした。");
      return;
    }
    if (session.current) {
      window.location.assign("/login?security=signed-out-device");
      return;
    }
    await loadSessions();
  };

  return (
    <article className="panel settings-panel account-security-settings" aria-label="アカウントの安全設定">
      <h3>アカウントの安全設定</h3>
      <p className="recurring-empty">端末紛失や身に覚えのないアクセスがある場合は、対象端末または全端末をログアウトしてください。</p>
      <div className="auth-session-list" aria-label="ログイン中の端末">
        <strong>ログイン中の端末</strong>
        {sessionError ? <p className="auth-form__error" role="alert">{sessionError}</p> : null}
        {sessions.filter((session) => !session.revoked_at).map((session) => (
          <div key={session.session_id} className="auth-session-item">
            <div>
              <span>{deviceLabel(session.user_agent)}{session.current ? "（この端末）" : ""}</span>
              <small>最終確認 {new Date(session.last_seen_at).toLocaleString("ja-JP")}</small>
            </div>
            <button className="chip" type="button" onClick={() => void revokeSession(session)}>ログアウト</button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <form className="account-security-form" action={passwordAction}>
        <input name="currentPassword" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" minLength={8} maxLength={72} placeholder="現在のパスワード" aria-label="現在のパスワード" required />
        <input name="newPassword" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" minLength={8} maxLength={72} placeholder="新しいパスワード" aria-label="新しいパスワード" required />
        <input name="confirmPassword" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" minLength={8} maxLength={72} placeholder="新しいパスワードを再入力" aria-label="新しいパスワードを再入力" required />
        {passwordState.error ? <p className="auth-form__error" role="alert">{passwordState.error}</p> : null}
        <button className="chip chip--active" type="submit" disabled={passwordPending}>{passwordPending ? "変更中..." : "パスワードを変更"}</button>
      </form>
      <form action={logoutAction} onSubmit={(event) => { if (!window.confirm("現在の端末を含むすべての端末からログアウトします。続けますか？")) event.preventDefault(); }}>
        {logoutState.error ? <p className="auth-form__error" role="alert">{logoutState.error}</p> : null}
        <button className="chip chip--danger" type="submit" disabled={logoutPending}>{logoutPending ? "ログアウト中..." : "すべての端末からログアウト"}</button>
      </form>
      <p className="recurring-empty">この一覧で無効化したセッションは、発行済みJWTでもAPIアクセスを拒否します。</p>
    </article>
  );
}
`);

    try {
      await client.query("begin");
      const context = await resolveHouseholdContext(client, request);
      if (!context) {
        await client.query("rollback");
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
      }
      if (!isHouseholdWritable(context)) {
        await client.query("rollback");
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "household_not_active" }, { status: 409 });
      }

      const expense = (await client.query<{ id: string; expense_date: string }>(expenseQuery, [id, context.householdId])).rows[0];
      if (!expense) {
        await client.query("rollback");
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "expense_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
      }

      if (period?.settled) {
        await client.query("rollback");
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "settled_period_locked" }, { status: 409 });
      }

      const deleted = (await client.query(deleteExpenseQuery, [id, context.householdId])).rows[0];
      if (!deleted) {
        await client.query("rollback");
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "expense_not_found" }, { status: 404 });
      }

      await recordHouseholdAuditEvent(client, context, {
        action: "expense_deleted",
        targetType: "expense",
        targetId: id,
      });
      await client.query("commit");
      return NextResponse.json({ deletedExpenseId: id });
    } catch (error) {
      await client.query("rollback");
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }`],

  `- \`202606070003_add_auth_sessions.sql\`: セッション識別子、端末情報、失効状態、セッション操作監査ログ
- \`202606070004_add_household_audit_logs.sql\`: 支出・精算・招待の内部監査ログ

## household_audit_logs

支出、精算、招待の重要な変更を追跡する内部監査ログ。通常の生活履歴や画面表示には利用せず、障害調査と不正対応のために保持する。

\`\`\`txt
id
household_id
actor_user_id
actor_member_id
action
target_type
target_id
metadata
created_at
\`\`\`

記録対象:

- 支出の作成、更新、削除
- 精算の確定、再オープン
- 招待の作成、無効化、受諾

\`metadata\` には年月、区分、有効日数など調査に必要な最小限の属性だけを保存する。金額、支出メモ、表示名、レシート画像、招待トークンやハッシュは保存しない。通常ユーザー向けのSELECT権限は付与せず、生活履歴とは分離する。

## household_lifecycle_events`);

  `- 世帯内 \`owner\` はアプリ管理者ではない。世帯内権限と運用管理者権限を混同しない。

### 3.5.1. 世帯操作の内部監査ログ

- 支出の作成・更新・削除、精算の確定・再オープン、招待の作成・無効化・受諾を \`household_audit_logs\` へ記録する。
- 監査記録は対象操作と同じDBトランザクションで追加し、操作だけ成功して監査記録が欠ける状態を作らない。
- 通常画面に表示する生活履歴とは分離し、通常ユーザー向けAPIやSELECT権限を提供しない。
- 金額、メモ、表示名、レシート画像、招待トークンやハッシュは監査ログへ保存しない。
- 保持期間と削除ジョブはデータ保持ポリシーのIssueで決定する。

### 3.6.`);

gh issue create --title "監査ログの365日自動削除と容量監視を実装する" --body $'## 優先度\n高\n\n## 背景\n`household_audit_logs` は365日保持と定義したが、期限切れログの削除処理は未実装。ユーザー増加後も削除されなければDB容量とインデックスが増え続け、Supabase Freeの500MB上限やProのディスク課金へ影響する。\n\n## 対応内容\n- `household_audit_logs` の365日超データを定期削除する\n- Supabase Cron / `pg_cron` を利用し、低負荷時間帯に小分けで削除する\n- セキュリティ事故・係争で保全対象になったログを削除対象から除外できるようにする\n- 削除件数、残存件数、最古日時、テーブル・インデックス容量を計測する\n- DB使用量が70% / 80% / 90%に達した場合の通知方針を決める\n- autovacuumで再利用可能領域が回収されているか確認する\n- 大量削除時のロック、WAL、バックアップ容量への影響を確認する\n\n## 完了条件\n- 365日超の監査ログが自動削除される\n- 保全指定ログは削除されない\n- 削除処理が一定件数ごとのバッチで動作する\n- テーブル・インデックス・DB全体容量を確認できる\n- 容量閾値超過を検知できる\n- migration、運用手順、テストが追加されている\n\n## 容量目安\n- 監査ログは1イベントあたり概ね0.5〜1KB程度を想定\n- 1世帯1日5イベントの場合、1,000世帯で年間約1〜2GBが目安\n- 実際の行サイズ、インデックス、WALを継続計測して見直す\n\n## 関連\n- #24\n- #37\n- #38'
gh issue create --title "DB・Storageの容量増加を監視し保持方針を整備する" --body $'## 優先度\n中-高\n\n## 背景\nユーザー数と利用年数が増えると、監査ログ以外にも支出履歴、分割明細、精算スナップショット、セッション履歴、レシート画像、OCR結果、バックアップが継続的に増加する。機能ごとの保持方針だけでなく、DB・Storage・バックアップを横断した容量予算と監視が必要。\n\n## 主な増加要因\n- `expenses` / `expense_splits`: 生活履歴として長期保持し、世帯数・利用年数に比例して増加\n- `settlement_period_events.settlement_snapshot`: 精算のたびに集計JSONを複製し、再確定回数と支出件数に応じて増加\n- `recurring_expense_occurrences`: テンプレート数 × 利用月数で増加\n- `auth_sessions` / `auth_session_audit_logs`: 端末変更、失効、再ログインで増加\n- `household_lifecycle_events`: 件数は少ないが長期保持\n- レシート画像・OCR結果: DB外のStorageが主だが、最も容量増加が大きくなる可能性が高い\n- DBバックアップ / WAL: 本体容量と更新量に応じて増加\n\n## 対応内容\n- DB、インデックス、Storage、バックアップの容量予算を環境別に定義する\n- テーブル別の件数、行サイズ、テーブルサイズ、インデックスサイズ、増加率を定期計測する\n- `settlement_snapshot` の保存範囲を見直し、必要なら圧縮・差分・要約へ変更する\n- 期限切れセッションと各種監査ログの削除ルールを定義する\n- レシート画像の最大サイズ、圧縮形式、サムネイル、保持期間、削除連動を#23で定義する\n- 世帯解消・退会後の長期履歴をオンラインDBに残す期間とarchive方法を決める\n- バックアップ世代数と復旧要件を#38と整合させる\n- Supabase Free 500MB、Pro 8GB込みを前提に70% / 80% / 90%の警告基準を設ける\n- 月次でユーザー数・世帯数・支出件数から6か月後/12か月後の容量を予測する\n- 数千万行が見込まれるテーブルのパーティション化判断基準を決める\n\n## 完了条件\n- 容量の大きい上位テーブルとStorage bucketを確認できる\n- データ種別ごとの保持・削除・archive方針が文書化されている\n- 容量閾値と通知先が定義されている\n- 6か月後/12か月後の容量予測が確認できる\n- 画像孤児、期限切れセッション、不要スナップショットを検出できる\n- 容量増加時のPro移行・ディスク拡張判断基準がある\n\n## 関連\n- #1\n- #23\n- #37\n- #38'

let text = fs.readFileSync('postgres/README.md', 'utf8');
const section = `
## 監査ログ保持

365日を超えた監査ログは、最大1,000件ずつ削除する。ローカルPostgreSQLには \`pg_cron\` を含めていないため、OS cronや運用ジョブから次を毎時実行する。

\`\`\`sql
select * from purge_household_audit_logs(365, 1000);
\`\`\`

保全が必要なログには、削除を停止する期限と理由を設定する。無期限保全は \`infinity\` を使う。

\`\`\`sql
update household_audit_logs
set retention_hold_until = 'infinity',
    retention_hold_reason = 'security_incident:INC-1234'
where id = '対象ログID';
\`\`\`

容量確認:

\`\`\`sql
select * from household_audit_log_storage_stats(365);
select * from database_capacity_status(8589934592);
\`\`\`

\`database_capacity_status\` は使用率70%から \`warning\`、80%から \`critical\`、90%から \`emergency\` を返す。削除結果は \`household_audit_retention_runs\` に90日だけ保持する。
`;
if (!text.includes('\n## RLS確認')) throw new Error('Missing postgres README section');
text = text.replace('\n## RLS確認', `${section}\n## RLS確認`);
fs.writeFileSync('postgres/README.md', text);
replace('Docs/data-model.md',

  '- `202606070004_add_household_audit_logs.sql`: 支出・精算・招待の内部監査ログ\n- `202606070005_add_household_audit_retention.sql`: 監査ログの保全指定、分割削除、容量集計、Supabase Cron');
replace('Docs/data-model.md',

  'metadata\nretention_hold_until\nretention_hold_reason\ncreated_at');
replace('Docs/data-model.md',
  '保持期間は作成から365日とし、期限を過ぎたログは定期バッチで物理削除する。セキュリティ事故や係争の調査対象として保全指定されたログだけは調査終了まで削除を延期する。レシート画像、OCR結果、退会ユーザー情報の保持期間は別途Issue #23で扱う。',
  '保持期間は作成から365日とし、期限を過ぎたログは最大1,000件の定期バッチで物理削除する。セキュリティ事故や係争の調査対象は `retention_hold_until` と `retention_hold_reason` で保全し、調査終了まで削除を延期する。レシート画像、OCR結果、退会ユーザー情報の保持期間は別途Issue #23で扱う。\n\nSupabaseでは毎時17分に `purge_household_audit_logs(365, 1000)` を実行する。削除結果は `household_audit_retention_runs` に記録し、実行履歴自体は90日で削除する。容量は `household_audit_log_storage_stats`、DB上限に対する使用率は `database_capacity_status` で確認する。');
replace('Docs/api-security-spec.md',
  '- 保持期間は作成から365日とし、期限後は定期バッチで物理削除する。セキュリティ事故や係争で保全指定されたログだけは調査終了まで削除を延期する。\n- レシート画像、OCR結果、退会ユーザー情報の保持期間はIssue #23で別途定義する。',
  '- 保持期間は作成から365日とし、期限後は定期バッチで物理削除する。セキュリティ事故や係争で保全指定されたログだけは調査終了まで削除を延期する。\n- 削除は最大1,000件ずつ `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` で行い、通常APIの書き込みを長時間ブロックしない。\n- 削除関数、保全指定、容量集計は通常ユーザーと `kakeibo_app` へ公開せず、DB ownerまたはSupabase `service_role` の運用処理だけに許可する。\n- Supabase Cronを毎時実行し、削除件数、期限超過残件数、最古日時、テーブル・インデックス容量を90日間記録する。\n- DB容量は上限の70%で `warning`、80%で `critical`、90%で `emergency` と判定する。\n- レシート画像、OCR結果、退会ユーザー情報の保持期間はIssue #23で別途定義する。');

}

  '  const authSessionId = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888";',
  '  const authSessionId = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888";\n  const auditRetentionIds = [\n    "99999999-aaaa-4999-8999-999999999991",\n    "99999999-aaaa-4999-8999-999999999992",\n    "99999999-aaaa-4999-8999-999999999993",\n    "99999999-aaaa-4999-8999-999999999994",\n  ];');
replace(
  '    await pool.query("delete from auth_session_audit_logs where target_session_id = $1", [authSessionId]);',
  '    await pool.query("delete from household_audit_logs where id = any($1::uuid[])", [auditRetentionIds]);\n    await pool.query("delete from household_audit_retention_runs where retention_days = 365 and batch_size = 1");\n    await pool.query("delete from auth_session_audit_logs where target_session_id = $1", [authSessionId]);');
const anchor = '  it("filters dashboard expenses by month and validates period input", async () => {';
const test = `  it("purges expired household audit logs in batches while preserving held logs", async () => {
    const primaryHouseholdId = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa";
    const primaryUserId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
    const primaryMemberId = "aaaaaaaa-1111-4111-8111-aaaaaaaa1111";

    await pool.query("delete from household_audit_logs where id = any($1::uuid[])", [auditRetentionIds]);
    await pool.query(\`
      insert into household_audit_logs (
        id, household_id, actor_user_id, actor_member_id, action, target_type, target_id,
        metadata, created_at, retention_hold_until, retention_hold_reason
      ) values
        ($1, $5, $6, $7, 'expense_created', 'expense', $1, '{}', now() - interval '500 days', null, null),
        ($2, $5, $6, $7, 'expense_updated', 'expense', $2, '{}', now() - interval '450 days', null, null),
        ($3, $5, $6, $7, 'expense_deleted', 'expense', $3, '{}', now() - interval '500 days', now() + interval '30 days', 'security_incident:TEST-1'),
        ($4, $5, $6, $7, 'expense_created', 'expense', $4, '{}', now() - interval '30 days', null, null)
    \`, [...auditRetentionIds, primaryHouseholdId, primaryUserId, primaryMemberId]);

    const before = (await pool.query<{ expired_count: string; held_count: string }>(
      "select expired_count::text, held_count::text from household_audit_log_storage_stats(365)",
    )).rows[0];
    assert.ok(Number(before.expired_count) >= 2);
    assert.ok(Number(before.held_count) >= 1);

    const firstRun = (await pool.query<{ deleted_count: number; remaining_expired_count: string }>(
      "select deleted_count, remaining_expired_count::text from purge_household_audit_logs(365, 1)",
    )).rows[0];
    assert.deepEqual(firstRun, { deleted_count: 1, remaining_expired_count: "1" });

    const secondRun = (await pool.query<{ deleted_count: number; remaining_expired_count: string }>(
      "select deleted_count, remaining_expired_count::text from purge_household_audit_logs(365, 1)",
    )).rows[0];
    assert.deepEqual(secondRun, { deleted_count: 1, remaining_expired_count: "0" });

    assert.deepEqual((await pool.query<{ id: string }>(
      "select id::text from household_audit_logs where id = any($1::uuid[]) order by id",
      [auditRetentionIds],
    )).rows, [{ id: auditRetentionIds[2] }, { id: auditRetentionIds[3] }]);

    const stats = (await pool.query<{ database_bytes: string }>(
      "select database_bytes::text from household_audit_log_storage_stats(365)",
    )).rows[0];
    const databaseBytes = Number(stats.database_bytes);
    const normal = (await pool.query<{ status: string }>("select status from database_capacity_status($1)", [databaseBytes * 2])).rows[0];
    const emergency = (await pool.query<{ status: string }>("select status from database_capacity_status($1)", [databaseBytes])).rows[0];
    assert.equal(normal.status, "normal");
    assert.equal(emergency.status, "emergency");
  });

`;

    ],

  );

to=`  perform cron.schedule(
    'purge-household-audit-logs',
    '17 * * * *',
    'select public.purge_household_audit_logs(365, 1000)'
  );

  select jobid into existing_job_id
  from cron.job
  where jobname = 'cleanup-household-audit-cron-history';

  if existing_job_id is not null then
    perform cron.unschedule(existing_job_id);
  end if;

  perform cron.schedule(
    'cleanup-household-audit-cron-history',
    '37 3 * * *',
    $$delete from cron.job_run_details
      where end_time < now() - interval '30 days'
        and jobid in (
          select jobid from cron.job
          where jobname in ('purge-household-audit-logs', 'cleanup-household-audit-cron-history')
        )$$
  );

        environment, resource_type, resource_name, total_bytes, captured_at
      ) values
        ($1, 'database', current_database(), 1000, now() - interval '30 days'),
        ($1, 'database', current_database(), 4000, now())
    \`, [environment]);

    const forecast = (await pool.query<{
      current_bytes: string; daily_growth_bytes: string;
      projected_6_month_bytes: string; projected_12_month_bytes: string;
      sample_count: string;
    }>("select current_bytes::text, daily_growth_bytes::text, projected_6_month_bytes::text, projected_12_month_bytes::text, sample_count::text from capacity_forecast($1, 'database', current_database(), 90)", [environment])).rows[0];
    assert.equal(forecast.current_bytes, "4000");
    assert.ok(Number(forecast.daily_growth_bytes) >= 99 && Number(forecast.daily_growth_bytes) <= 101);
    assert.ok(Number(forecast.projected_6_month_bytes) > 22000);
    assert.ok(Number(forecast.projected_12_month_bytes) > Number(forecast.projected_6_month_bytes));
    assert.equal(forecast.sample_count, "2");

    const budget = (await pool.query<{ status: string; usage_percent: string }>(
      "select status, usage_percent::text from capacity_budget_status($1) where resource_type = 'database'",
      [environment],
    )).rows[0];
    assert.equal(budget.status, "critical");
    assert.equal(budget.usage_percent, "80.00");

    const captured = (await pool.query<{ count: number }>(
      "select capture_database_capacity_snapshot($1) as count",
      [environment],
    )).rows[0];
    assert.ok(captured.count > 1);
    assert.ok((await pool.query(
      "select 1 from capacity_snapshots where environment = $1 and resource_type = 'relation' and resource_name = 'expenses'",
      [environment],
    )).rowCount > 0);

    const findings = (await pool.query<{ finding_type: string; item_count: string }>(
      "select finding_type, item_count::text from capacity_data_findings()",
    )).rows;
    assert.deepEqual(findings.map((finding) => finding.finding_type), [
      "expired_auth_sessions",
      "oversized_settlement_snapshots",
      "duplicate_settlement_snapshots",
      "receipt_storage_references",
    ]);

    await pool.query("delete from capacity_snapshots where environment = $1", [environment]);
    await pool.query("delete from capacity_budgets where environment = $1", [environment]);
  });

`;

node <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs');
const content=`# 容量管理

## 目的

DB、インデックス、Supabase Storage、バックアップの増加を定期計測し、読み取り専用化や想定外課金の前に対応する。

## 容量予算

2026年6月時点のSupabase基準値:

| 環境 | DB | Storage | バックアップ |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Supabase Free | 500 MB | 1 GB | プラン仕様に従う |
| Supabase Pro | 8 GB | 100 GB | 日次、7日保持 |
| ローカル | ディスクの70%未満 | 外部Storageなし | #38で定義 |

本番プランはDB設定 \`app.capacity_environment\` に \`supabase_free\` または \`supabase_pro\` を指定する。未設定時は保守的に \`supabase_free\` を使う。

## 警告基準

| 使用率 | 状態 | 対応 |
|---:|---|---|
| 70%未満 | normal | 日次スナップショットのみ |
| 70%以上 | warning | 日次通知、増加要因と12か月予測を確認 |
| 80%以上 | critical | 即時通知、不要データ整理、プラン変更を判断 |
| 90%以上 | emergency | 書き込み停止前の緊急対応、Pro移行またはディスク拡張 |

Proのディスク自動拡張は90%付近で行われるが、24時間内の拡張回数制限がある。アプリ側では自動拡張に依存せず、80%時点で対応を開始する。

## 日次計測

Supabase Cronは毎日02:12 UTCに次を記録する。

- DB全体容量
- public schemaのテーブル・インデックス容量
- 行数、dead tuple数、最終autovacuum時刻
- Storage bucket別のファイル数・合計容量

スナップショットは400日保持する。

ローカル確認:

\`\`\`sql
select capture_database_capacity_snapshot('local');
select * from capacity_budget_status('supabase_free');
select * from capacity_forecast('supabase_free', 'database', current_database(), 90);
select * from capacity_data_findings();
\`\`\`

## 増加予測

直近90日の最古値と最新値から1日あたりの増加量を算出し、183日後と365日後を線形予測する。

- サンプルが2件未満の場合は増加量を0として表示する
- データ移行や大量削除後は直線予測が歪むため、実施日を運用記録へ残す
- 12か月予測が80%を超える場合は、現在値が70%未満でも対応計画を作る

## データ別方針

| データ | 方針 |
|---|---|
| 支出・分割明細 | 生活履歴としてオンライン保持。数千万行または月次クエリ劣化時に月単位パーティションを検討 |
| 精算イベント | 履歴保持。64KB超または連続重複スナップショットを検出対象にする |
| 監査ログ | 365日保持。保全指定を除き最大1,000件ずつ削除 |
| セッション | 期限切れ・失効から30日超を整理候補として検出 |
| レシート画像 | Storageへ保存。最大サイズ、圧縮、保持期間は#23で定義 |
| 解消済み世帯 | 過去履歴を保持。オンライン保持期間とarchive方式は#23・#22と整合させる |
| バックアップ | 世代数、RPO、RTO、Storageファイルの別バックアップを#38で定義 |

## Storage整合性

\`capacity_data_findings()\` は次を検出する。

- \`expenses.receipt_image_path\` があるが \`storage.objects\` に存在しない画像
- \`storage.objects\` に存在するが支出から参照されない画像

\`storage\` schemaは読み取り専用として扱う。孤児画像を削除する場合はSQLでmetadataを削除せず、必ずSupabase Storage APIを使う。DBバックアップにはStorageの実ファイルが含まれないため、#38で別バックアップを設計する。

## 通知

通知連携は#37のログ・管理画面で実装する。

- warning: 日次通知
- critical: 即時通知
- emergency: 即時通知と運用担当へのエスカレーション
- 取得失敗: 24時間スナップショットがない場合に通知

## 拡張判断

- FreeでDB予測が400MBを超える、またはStorage予測が800MBを超える: Pro移行を計画
- ProでDB使用率80%以上: ディスク拡張またはデータ整理
- 単一テーブルが1,000万行超、または月次検索の性能目標を超える: パーティション化を検証
- Storage画像が予算の80%以上: 圧縮・サムネイル・保持期間を見直す
`;
fs.writeFileSync('Docs/capacity-management.md',content);
let s=fs.readFileSync('Docs/data-model.md','utf8');

if(!s.includes(from))throw new Error('missing data model migration line');
fs.writeFileSync('Docs/data-model.md',s.replace(from,to));
