const fs = require('fs');
const files = {
  'scripts/backup-postgres.sh': `#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "\${BACKUP_DATABASE_URL:?BACKUP_DATABASE_URL is required}"

backup_dir=\${BACKUP_DIR:-./backups}
backup_prefix=\${BACKUP_PREFIX:-kakeibo}
retention_days=\${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS:-14}
pg_dump_bin=\${PG_DUMP_BIN:-pg_dump}
pg_restore_bin=\${PG_RESTORE_BIN:-pg_restore}

case "$retention_days" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*)
    echo "BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS must be a non-negative integer" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

command -v "$pg_dump_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$pg_dump_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v "$pg_restore_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$pg_restore_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "sha256sum is required" >&2; exit 1; }

umask 077
mkdir -p "$backup_dir"
timestamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
base_name="\${backup_prefix}-\${timestamp}"
temporary_dump="$backup_dir/.\${base_name}.dump.tmp"
list_file="$backup_dir/.\${base_name}.list.tmp"
artifact_name="\${base_name}.dump"
artifact_path="$backup_dir/$artifact_name"
metadata_path="$backup_dir/\${base_name}.json"
checksum_path="$artifact_path.sha256"

cleanup() {
  rm -f "$temporary_dump" "$list_file"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

"$pg_dump_bin" \
  --dbname="$BACKUP_DATABASE_URL" \
  --format=custom \
  --compress=9 \
  --no-owner \
  --no-privileges \
  --file="$temporary_dump"

"$pg_restore_bin" --list "$temporary_dump" > "$list_file"
for required_table in households household_members expenses expense_splits; do
  if ! grep -Eq "TABLE( DATA)? public $required_table( |$)" "$list_file"; then
    echo "Backup is missing required table: $required_table" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

encrypted=false
if [ -n "\${BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE:-}" ]; then
  command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "openssl is required for encrypted backups" >&2; exit 1; }
  artifact_name="\${artifact_name}.enc"
  artifact_path="$backup_dir/$artifact_name"
  checksum_path="$artifact_path.sha256"
  openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -salt -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
    -in "$temporary_dump" -out "$artifact_path" \
    -pass env:BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE
  encrypted=true
else
  mv "$temporary_dump" "$artifact_path"
fi

artifact_size=$(wc -c < "$artifact_path" | tr -d ' ')
artifact_sha256=$(sha256sum "$artifact_path" | awk '{print $1}')
(
  cd "$backup_dir"
  printf '%s  %s\\n' "$artifact_sha256" "$artifact_name" > "$(basename "$checksum_path")"
)

pg_dump_version=$("$pg_dump_bin" --version | sed 's/"/\\\\"/g')
printf '{\\n  "created_at": "%s",\\n  "artifact": "%s",\\n  "encrypted": %s,\\n  "size_bytes": %s,\\n  "sha256": "%s",\\n  "format": "postgres-custom",\\n  "pg_dump_version": "%s"\\n}\\n' \
  "$timestamp" "$artifact_name" "$encrypted" "$artifact_size" "$artifact_sha256" "$pg_dump_version" > "$metadata_path"

find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "\${backup_prefix}-*" -mtime "+$retention_days" -delete

printf '%s\\n' "$artifact_path"
`,
  'scripts/verify-postgres-backup.sh': `#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 BACKUP_FILE" >&2
  exit 2
fi

: "\${RESTORE_DATABASE_URL:?RESTORE_DATABASE_URL is required}"
if [ "\${ALLOW_RESTORE_OVERWRITE:-}" != "true" ]; then
  echo "Set ALLOW_RESTORE_OVERWRITE=true for a disposable restore database" >&2
  exit 2
fi

backup_file=$1
pg_restore_bin=\${PG_RESTORE_BIN:-pg_restore}
psql_bin=\${PSQL_BIN:-psql}

[ -f "$backup_file" ] || { echo "Backup file not found: $backup_file" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v "$pg_restore_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$pg_restore_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v "$psql_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$psql_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "sha256sum is required" >&2; exit 1; }

backup_dir=$(dirname "$backup_file")
backup_name=$(basename "$backup_file")
checksum_file="$backup_file.sha256"
if [ -f "$checksum_file" ]; then
  (cd "$backup_dir" && sha256sum --check "$(basename "$checksum_file")")
else
  echo "Checksum file not found; refusing restore: $checksum_file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

temporary_dump=
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$temporary_dump" ]; then rm -f "$temporary_dump"; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

restore_file=$backup_file
case "$backup_name" in
  *.enc)
    : "\${RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE:?RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE is required for encrypted backups}"
    command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "openssl is required for encrypted backups" >&2; exit 1; }
    temporary_dump=$(mktemp "\${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kakeibo-restore.XXXXXX.dump")
    openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
      -in "$backup_file" -out "$temporary_dump" \
      -pass env:RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE
    restore_file=$temporary_dump
    ;;
esac

"$pg_restore_bin" \
  --dbname="$RESTORE_DATABASE_URL" \
  --clean \
  --if-exists \
  --no-owner \
  --no-privileges \
  --single-transaction \
  "$restore_file"

"$psql_bin" "$RESTORE_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
do $$
declare
  required_table text;
begin
  foreach required_table in array array[
    'households', 'household_members', 'expenses', 'expense_splits',
    'settlement_periods', 'household_audit_logs', 'capacity_snapshots'
  ] loop
    if to_regclass('public.' || required_table) is null then
      raise exception 'restore_missing_required_table: %', required_table;
    end if;
  end loop;
end;
$$;

select json_build_object(
  'households', (select count(*) from households),
  'members', (select count(*) from household_members),
  'expenses', (select count(*) from expenses),
  'audit_logs', (select count(*) from household_audit_logs)
)::text as restore_summary;
SQL
`,
  '.github/workflows/database-backup.yml': `name: Encrypted database backup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "37 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: database-backup
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify backup configuration
        env:
          BACKUP_DATABASE_URL: \${{ secrets.BACKUP_DATABASE_URL }}

  'Docs/backup-recovery.md': `# バックアップ・復旧方針

## 目的

誤削除、マイグレーション事故、サービス障害、プロジェクト削除から家計データを復旧できる状態を維持する。バックアップの作成成功だけでなく、定期的な復元確認を完了条件とする。

## 目標

| 項目 | MVP基準 | 拡張判断 |
|---|---|---|
| RPO | 24時間以内 | 1日の損失を許容できなくなったらPITRを有効化 |
| RTO | 4時間以内 | 復元訓練で4時間を超えたら手順・プランを見直す |
| DB保持 | 日次14世代を暗号化して別管理 | 法務・利用規模に応じて30日以上へ延長 |
| 復元訓練 | CIで毎回、運用環境では四半期ごと | 大規模マイグレーション前にも実施 |

## バックアップ構成

### Supabase管理バックアップ

2026年6月時点で、Supabase Proは日次バックアップを7日保持する。Freeでは管理バックアップに依存せず、定期的な論理エクスポートを行う。PITRを有効にすると秒単位の復旧点を選べるが、追加費用が発生する。

管理バックアップからの復元中はプロジェクトが停止する。カスタムロールのパスワード、Edge Functions、Auth設定、APIキー、Realtime設定など、DB外の設定は別途再設定が必要になる。

### 独立した論理バックアップ

`.github/workflows/database-backup.yml` は毎日03:37 UTCに `pg_dump` カスタム形式を作成し、AES-256-CBCとPBKDF2で暗号化してGitHub Actions Artifactへ14日間保存する。

次をRepository Actionsに設定する。

- Variable `BACKUP_ENABLED=true`
- Secret `BACKUP_DATABASE_URL`: 本番DBのバックアップ専用接続URL
- Secret `BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE`: 十分に長いランダム文字列。DB接続情報と別の保管先にも記録する

未設定時は定期ジョブをスキップする。平文ダンプ、接続URL、暗号鍵はArtifactやログへ出力しない。

Supabaseでは互換性上、定常運用の取得方法を `supabase db dump` へ切り替える判断も可能とする。現在のスクリプトはアプリ管理テーブルを含むPostgreSQL論理バックアップを対象とする。

## Storage

DBバックアップに含まれるのは `storage.objects` などのメタデータだけで、レシート画像の実体は含まれない。レシート機能の導入前にIssue #23で保存期間を確定し、Storage APIまたはS3互換APIを使った別バックアップを追加する。

DBだけを過去時点へ戻すと、画像メタデータと実ファイルが不一致になる可能性がある。復旧後は `capacity_data_findings()` で欠損・孤児画像を確認する。

## ローカル実行

バックアップ:

\`\`\`bash
BACKUP_DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_PRODUCTION" \\
BACKUP_DIR=./backups \\
./scripts/backup-postgres.sh
\`\`\`

暗号化する場合:

\`\`\`bash
BACKUP_DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_PRODUCTION" \\
BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE='separate-secret' \\
BACKUP_DIR=./backups \\
./scripts/backup-postgres.sh
\`\`\`

復旧確認は必ず破棄可能なDBを指定する。

\`\`\`bash
RESTORE_DATABASE_URL='postgresql://kakeibo:kakeibo_password@localhost:5433/kakeibo_restore' \\
ALLOW_RESTORE_OVERWRITE=true \\
./scripts/verify-postgres-backup.sh ./backups/kakeibo-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.dump
\`\`\`

暗号化済みの場合は `RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE` も指定する。

## 復旧手順

1. インシデント発生時刻と最後の正常時刻を確定する
2. 書き込みを停止し、現DBのスナップショットを取得する
3. 目標時刻より前の最新バックアップを選び、SHA-256を検証する
4. 新規または破棄可能なDBへ復元し、必須テーブルと件数を確認する
5. 支出・精算・世帯・認証セッションの整合性を確認する
6. Storageの欠損・孤児を確認する
7. 接続先を切り替え、APIと主要導線のスモークテストを行う
8. 復旧時刻、データ損失範囲、所要時間、再発防止策を記録する

本番DBへの直接上書き復元は行わない。Supabase管理バックアップを同一プロジェクトへ戻す場合のみ、停止時間を告知したうえでDashboardの確認操作を使う。

## 監視と失敗時対応

- 定期ジョブ失敗: Issue #37の運用通知へ連携する
- 24時間以上成功成果物がない: `critical`
- 復元検証失敗: `critical`。新しいバックアップを正常扱いしない
- Artifact容量が予算の80%超: 保持世代または保存先を見直す
- DBの12か月予測がFree 400MB、Storage 800MBを超える: Pro移行を計画する

## 公式資料

- [Supabase Database Backups](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/backups)
- [Backup and Restore using the CLI](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/migrating-within-supabase/backup-restore)
- [Restore to a new project](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/clone-project)
`

  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, content);
  if (mode) fs.chmodSync(file, mode);
}
write('scripts/backup-postgres.sh', String.raw`#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "\${BACKUP_DATABASE_URL:?BACKUP_DATABASE_URL is required}"

backup_dir=\${BACKUP_DIR:-./backups}
backup_prefix=\${BACKUP_PREFIX:-kakeibo}
retention_days=\${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS:-14}
pg_dump_bin=\${PG_DUMP_BIN:-pg_dump}
pg_restore_bin=\${PG_RESTORE_BIN:-pg_restore}

case "$retention_days" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*)
    echo "BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS must be a non-negative integer" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

command -v "$pg_dump_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$pg_dump_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v "$pg_restore_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$pg_restore_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "sha256sum is required" >&2; exit 1; }

umask 077
mkdir -p "$backup_dir"
timestamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
base_name="\${backup_prefix}-\${timestamp}"
temporary_dump="$backup_dir/.\${base_name}.dump.tmp"
list_file="$backup_dir/.\${base_name}.list.tmp"
artifact_name="\${base_name}.dump"
artifact_path="$backup_dir/$artifact_name"
metadata_path="$backup_dir/\${base_name}.json"
checksum_path="$artifact_path.sha256"

cleanup() {
  rm -f "$temporary_dump" "$list_file"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

"$pg_dump_bin" \
  --dbname="$BACKUP_DATABASE_URL" \
  --format=custom \
  --compress=9 \
  --no-owner \
  --no-privileges \
  --file="$temporary_dump"

"$pg_restore_bin" --list "$temporary_dump" > "$list_file"
for required_table in households household_members expenses expense_splits; do
  if ! grep -Eq "TABLE( DATA)? public $required_table( |$)" "$list_file"; then
    echo "Backup is missing required table: $required_table" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

encrypted=false
if [ -n "\${BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE:-}" ]; then
  command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "openssl is required for encrypted backups" >&2; exit 1; }
  artifact_name="\${artifact_name}.enc"
  artifact_path="$backup_dir/$artifact_name"
  checksum_path="$artifact_path.sha256"
  openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -salt -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
    -in "$temporary_dump" -out "$artifact_path" \
    -pass env:BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE
  encrypted=true
else
  mv "$temporary_dump" "$artifact_path"
fi

artifact_size=$(wc -c < "$artifact_path" | tr -d ' ')
artifact_sha256=$(sha256sum "$artifact_path" | awk '{print $1}')
(
  cd "$backup_dir"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$artifact_sha256" "$artifact_name" > "$(basename "$checksum_path")"
)

pg_dump_version=$("$pg_dump_bin" --version | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
printf '{\n  "created_at": "%s",\n  "artifact": "%s",\n  "encrypted": %s,\n  "size_bytes": %s,\n  "sha256": "%s",\n  "format": "postgres-custom",\n  "pg_dump_version": "%s"\n}\n' \
  "$timestamp" "$artifact_name" "$encrypted" "$artifact_size" "$artifact_sha256" "$pg_dump_version" > "$metadata_path"

find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "\${backup_prefix}-*" -mtime "+$retention_days" -delete

printf '%s\n' "$artifact_path"
`, 0o755);

write('scripts/verify-postgres-backup.sh', String.raw`#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 BACKUP_FILE" >&2
  exit 2
fi

: "\${RESTORE_DATABASE_URL:?RESTORE_DATABASE_URL is required}"
if [ "\${ALLOW_RESTORE_OVERWRITE:-}" != "true" ]; then
  echo "Set ALLOW_RESTORE_OVERWRITE=true for a disposable restore database" >&2
  exit 2
fi

backup_file=$1
pg_restore_bin=\${PG_RESTORE_BIN:-pg_restore}
psql_bin=\${PSQL_BIN:-psql}

[ -f "$backup_file" ] || { echo "Backup file not found: $backup_file" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v "$pg_restore_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$pg_restore_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v "$psql_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$psql_bin is required" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "sha256sum is required" >&2; exit 1; }

backup_dir=$(dirname "$backup_file")
checksum_file="$backup_file.sha256"
if [ -f "$checksum_file" ]; then
  (cd "$backup_dir" && sha256sum --check "$(basename "$checksum_file")")
else
  echo "Checksum file not found; refusing restore: $checksum_file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

temporary_dump=
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$temporary_dump" ]; then rm -f "$temporary_dump"; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

restore_file=$backup_file
case "$backup_file" in
  *.enc)
    : "\${RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE:?RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE is required for encrypted backups}"
    command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "openssl is required for encrypted backups" >&2; exit 1; }
    temporary_dump=$(mktemp "\${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kakeibo-restore.XXXXXX.dump")
    openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
      -in "$backup_file" -out "$temporary_dump" \
      -pass env:RESTORE_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE
    restore_file=$temporary_dump
    ;;
esac

"$pg_restore_bin" \
  --dbname="$RESTORE_DATABASE_URL" \
  --clean \
  --if-exists \
  --no-owner \
  --no-privileges \
  --single-transaction \
  "$restore_file"

"$psql_bin" "$RESTORE_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
do $$
declare
  required_table text;
begin
  foreach required_table in array array[
    'households', 'household_members', 'expenses', 'expense_splits',
    'settlement_periods', 'household_audit_logs', 'capacity_snapshots'
  ] loop
    if to_regclass('public.' || required_table) is null then
      raise exception 'restore_missing_required_table: %', required_table;
    end if;
  end loop;
end;
$$;

select json_build_object(
  'households', (select count(*) from households),
  'members', (select count(*) from household_members),
  'expenses', (select count(*) from expenses),
  'audit_logs', (select count(*) from household_audit_logs)
)::text as restore_summary;
SQL
`, 0o755);

write('.github/workflows/database-backup.yml', String.raw`name: Encrypted database backup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "37 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: database-backup
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  backup:
    if: vars.BACKUP_ENABLED == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify backup configuration
        env:
          BACKUP_DATABASE_URL: \${{ secrets.BACKUP_DATABASE_URL }}
          BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE: \${{ secrets.BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE }}
        run: |
          test -n "$BACKUP_DATABASE_URL"
          test -n "$BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE"
          command -v pg_dump
          command -v pg_restore
          command -v openssl

      - name: Create encrypted logical backup
        env:
          BACKUP_DATABASE_URL: \${{ secrets.BACKUP_DATABASE_URL }}
          BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE: \${{ secrets.BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE }}
          BACKUP_DIR: backup-output
          BACKUP_PREFIX: kakeibo-production
          BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS: 14
        run: ./scripts/backup-postgres.sh

      - name: Upload encrypted backup
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kakeibo-database-backup-\${{ github.run_id }}
          path: backup-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
`);

node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
for (const file of ['scripts/backup-postgres.sh', 'scripts/verify-postgres-backup.sh', '.github/workflows/database-backup.yml']) {
  let text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  text = text.replaceAll('\\${', '${');

}
let doc = fs.readFileSync('Docs/backup-recovery.md', 'utf8');
doc = doc.replaceAll(' \\\\\n', ' \\\n');
fs.writeFileSync('Docs/backup-recovery.md', doc);

let ci = fs.readFileSync('.github/workflows/ci.yml', 'utf8');
const marker = `      - name: Test\n        env:\n`;
const insert = `      - name: Verify backup and restore\n        env:\n          BACKUP_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://kakeibo:kakeibo_password@localhost:5433/kakeibo_production\n          BACKUP_DIR: /tmp/kakeibo-backups\n          BACKUP_PREFIX: ci\n          BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS: 1\n          RESTORE_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://kakeibo:kakeibo_password@localhost:5433/kakeibo_restore\n          ALLOW_RESTORE_OVERWRITE: true\n        run: |\n          command -v pg_dump\n          command -v pg_restore\n          rm -rf /tmp/kakeibo-backups\n          docker compose exec -T db psql -U kakeibo -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \\\n            -c \"drop database if exists kakeibo_restore with (force)\" \\\n            -c \"create database kakeibo_restore\"\n          backup_file=$(./scripts/backup-postgres.sh)\n          ./scripts/verify-postgres-backup.sh \"$backup_file\"\n          restored_expenses=$(psql \"$RESTORE_DATABASE_URL\" -tAc \"select count(*) from expenses\")\n          test \"$restored_expenses\" = \"4\"\n\n`;
if (!ci.includes(marker)) throw new Error('CI marker missing');
ci = ci.replace(marker, insert + marker);

let ignore = fs.readFileSync('.gitignore', 'utf8');
const ignoreMarker = `# Logs\n`;
if (!ignore.includes('/backups/')) ignore = ignore.replace(ignoreMarker, `# Local backup artifacts\n/backups/\n/backup-output/\n\n` + ignoreMarker);

fs.writeFileSync('Docs/capacity-management.md', capacity);

node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
function write(file, content) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(file, content); }
function migration({ prefix = '', userTable, currentUser, appRole, forceRls }) {
const p = prefix;
return `create table if not exists ${p}admin_roles (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references ${userTable}(id) on delete cascade,
  role text not null check (role in ('support_admin', 'security_admin', 'system_admin')),
  active boolean not null default true,
  created_by_user_id uuid references ${userTable}(id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  constraint admin_roles_revoked_state check (
    (active and revoked_at is null) or (not active and revoked_at is not null)
  )
);

create unique index if not exists admin_roles_active_user_role_idx
  on ${p}admin_roles (user_id, role) where active;

create table if not exists ${p}user_account_controls (
  user_id uuid primary key references ${userTable}(id) on delete cascade,
  status text not null default 'active' check (status in ('active', 'suspended')),
  reason text,
  changed_by_user_id uuid references ${userTable}(id) on delete set null,
  suspended_at timestamptz,
  restored_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint user_account_controls_reason_required check (
    status = 'active' or nullif(trim(reason), '') is not null
  )
);

create table if not exists ${p}admin_audit_logs (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  actor_user_id uuid references ${userTable}(id) on delete set null,
  actor_admin_role text check (actor_admin_role in ('support_admin', 'security_admin', 'system_admin')),
  target_user_id uuid references ${userTable}(id) on delete set null,
  target_household_id uuid references ${p}households(id) on delete set null,
  action text not null check (action in (
    'user_searched', 'account_suspended', 'account_restored',
    'admin_role_granted', 'admin_role_revoked', 'audit_logs_viewed'
  )),
  outcome text not null check (outcome in ('success', 'denied')),
  reason text not null check (nullif(trim(reason), '') is not null),
  metadata jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object'),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists admin_audit_logs_created_idx on ${p}admin_audit_logs (created_at desc);
create index if not exists admin_audit_logs_actor_idx on ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists admin_audit_logs_target_idx on ${p}admin_audit_logs (target_user_id, created_at desc);

alter table ${p}auth_session_audit_logs drop constraint if exists auth_session_audit_logs_action_check;
alter table ${p}auth_session_audit_logs add constraint auth_session_audit_logs_action_check
  check (action in ('session_revoked', 'all_sessions_revoked', 'admin_sessions_revoked'));

revoke all on ${p}admin_roles, ${p}user_account_controls, ${p}admin_audit_logs from public;
revoke all on ${p}admin_roles, ${p}user_account_controls, ${p}admin_audit_logs from ${appRole};
grant select on ${p}user_account_controls to ${appRole};

alter table ${p}admin_roles enable row level security;
${forceRls}alter table ${p}user_account_controls enable row level security;
${forceRls}alter table ${p}admin_audit_logs enable row level security;
${forceRls}
create policy user_account_controls_self on ${p}user_account_controls for select to ${appRole}
  using (user_id = ${currentUser});

create or replace function ${p}active_admin_role(target_user_id uuid, allowed_roles text[])
returns text
language sql stable security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
  select roles.role
  from ${p}admin_roles roles
  where roles.user_id = target_user_id and roles.active and roles.role = any(allowed_roles)
  order by case roles.role when 'system_admin' then 1 when 'security_admin' then 2 else 3 end
  limit 1;
$$;

create or replace function ${p}admin_lookup_users(search_term text, result_limit integer, access_reason text)
returns table (
  user_id uuid, email text, account_status text,
  household_count bigint, active_session_count bigint
)
language plpgsql security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  actor_id uuid := ${currentUser};
  actor_role text;
begin
  if actor_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  if result_limit < 1 or result_limit > 100 then raise exception 'result_limit_out_of_range' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  if nullif(trim(access_reason), '') is null then raise exception 'access_reason_required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  actor_role := ${p}active_admin_role(actor_id, array['support_admin', 'security_admin', 'system_admin']);
  if actor_role is null then
    insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, action, outcome, reason)
    values (actor_id, 'user_searched', 'denied', trim(access_reason));
    return;
  end if;
  insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, actor_admin_role, action, outcome, reason, metadata)
  values (actor_id, actor_role, 'user_searched', 'success', trim(access_reason),
    jsonb_build_object('queryLength', length(trim(search_term)), 'resultLimit', result_limit));
  return query
  select users.id, users.email::text, coalesce(controls.status, 'active'),
    count(distinct members.household_id),
    count(distinct sessions.session_id) filter (where sessions.revoked_at is null and (sessions.expires_at is null or sessions.expires_at > now()))
  from ${userTable} users
  left join ${p}user_account_controls controls on controls.user_id = users.id
  left join ${p}household_members members on members.user_id = users.id
  left join ${p}auth_sessions sessions on sessions.user_id = users.id
  where nullif(trim(search_term), '') is null or users.email ilike '%' || trim(search_term) || '%'
  group by users.id, users.email, controls.status
  order by users.email
  limit result_limit;
end;
$$;

create or replace function ${p}admin_set_account_status(target_user_id uuid, target_status text, change_reason text)
returns table (success boolean, account_status text)
language plpgsql security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  actor_id uuid := ${currentUser};
  actor_role text;
  audit_action text;
begin
  if actor_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  if target_status not in ('active', 'suspended') then raise exception 'invalid_account_status' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  if nullif(trim(change_reason), '') is null then raise exception 'change_reason_required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  audit_action := case target_status when 'suspended' then 'account_suspended' else 'account_restored' end;
  actor_role := ${p}active_admin_role(actor_id, array['security_admin', 'system_admin']);
  if actor_role is null or actor_id = target_user_id or not exists (select 1 from ${userTable} where id = target_user_id) then
    insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, actor_admin_role, target_user_id, action, outcome, reason)
    values (actor_id, actor_role, target_user_id, audit_action, 'denied', trim(change_reason));
    return query select false, coalesce((select controls.status from ${p}user_account_controls controls where controls.user_id = target_user_id), 'active');
    return;
  end if;
  insert into ${p}user_account_controls (user_id, status, reason, changed_by_user_id, suspended_at, restored_at, updated_at)
  values (
    target_user_id, target_status, trim(change_reason), actor_id,
    case when target_status = 'suspended' then now() end,
    case when target_status = 'active' then now() end,
    now()
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do update set
    status = excluded.status, reason = excluded.reason, changed_by_user_id = excluded.changed_by_user_id,
    suspended_at = case when excluded.status = 'suspended' then now() else ${p}user_account_controls.suspended_at end,
    restored_at = case when excluded.status = 'active' then now() else null end,
    updated_at = now();
  if target_status = 'suspended' then
    update ${p}auth_sessions set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, now()), revoked_reason = coalesce(revoked_reason, 'admin_suspended')
    where user_id = target_user_id;
    insert into ${p}auth_session_audit_logs (actor_user_id, target_user_id, action, reason)
    values (actor_id, target_user_id, 'admin_sessions_revoked', trim(change_reason));
  end if;
  insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, actor_admin_role, target_user_id, action, outcome, reason)
  values (actor_id, actor_role, target_user_id, audit_action, 'success', trim(change_reason));
  return query select true, target_status;
end;
$$;

create or replace function ${p}admin_set_role(target_user_id uuid, target_role text, enable_role boolean, change_reason text)
returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
set row_security = off
as $$
declare
  actor_id uuid := ${currentUser};
  actor_role text;
  audit_action text := case when enable_role then 'admin_role_granted' else 'admin_role_revoked' end;
begin
  if actor_id is null then raise exception 'unauthenticated' using errcode = '28000'; end if;
  if target_role not in ('support_admin', 'security_admin', 'system_admin') then raise exception 'invalid_admin_role' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  if nullif(trim(change_reason), '') is null then raise exception 'change_reason_required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  actor_role := ${p}active_admin_role(actor_id, array['system_admin']);
  if actor_role is null or not exists (select 1 from ${userTable} where id = target_user_id) then
    insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, actor_admin_role, target_user_id, action, outcome, reason, metadata)
    values (actor_id, actor_role, target_user_id, audit_action, 'denied', trim(change_reason), jsonb_build_object('role', target_role));
    return false;
  end if;
  if not enable_role and target_user_id = actor_id and target_role = 'system_admin'
    and (select count(*) from ${p}admin_roles where role = 'system_admin' and active) <= 1 then
    insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, actor_admin_role, target_user_id, action, outcome, reason, metadata)
    values (actor_id, actor_role, target_user_id, audit_action, 'denied', trim(change_reason), jsonb_build_object('role', target_role, 'lastSystemAdmin', true));
    return false;
  end if;
  if enable_role then
    update ${p}admin_roles set active = true, revoked_at = null, created_by_user_id = actor_id, created_at = now()
    where user_id = target_user_id and role = target_role and not active;
    if not found then
      insert into ${p}admin_roles (user_id, role, created_by_user_id)
      values (target_user_id, target_role, actor_id)
      on conflict do nothing;
    end if;
  else
    update ${p}admin_roles set active = false, revoked_at = now()
    where user_id = target_user_id and role = target_role and active;
  end if;
  insert into ${p}admin_audit_logs (actor_user_id, actor_admin_role, target_user_id, action, outcome, reason, metadata)
  values (actor_id, actor_role, target_user_id, audit_action, 'success', trim(change_reason), jsonb_build_object('role', target_role));
  return true;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function ${p}active_admin_role(uuid, text[]) from public;
revoke all on function ${p}admin_lookup_users(text, integer, text) from public;
revoke all on function ${p}admin_set_account_status(uuid, text, text) from public;
revoke all on function ${p}admin_set_role(uuid, text, boolean, text) from public;
grant execute on function ${p}admin_lookup_users(text, integer, text) to ${appRole};
grant execute on function ${p}admin_set_account_status(uuid, text, text) to ${appRole};
grant execute on function ${p}admin_set_role(uuid, text, boolean, text) to ${appRole};
`;
}

  );

    (match, prefix = '') => {
      const force = prefix ? '' : `alter table admin_roles force row level security;\nalter table user_account_controls force row level security;\nalter table admin_audit_logs force row level security;\n`;
      return `alter table ${prefix}admin_roles enable row level security;\nalter table ${prefix}user_account_controls enable row level security;\nalter table ${prefix}admin_audit_logs enable row level security;\n${force}`;
    },
  );
  const prefix = file.startsWith('supabase') ? 'public.' : '';
  const role = file.startsWith('supabase') ? 'authenticated' : 'kakeibo_app';
  sql = sql.replace(
    `create policy user_account_controls_self on ${prefix}user_account_controls for select to ${role}`,
    `drop policy if exists user_account_controls_self on ${prefix}user_account_controls;\ncreate policy user_account_controls_self on ${prefix}user_account_controls for select to ${role}`,
  );
  const oldRoleBlock = `  if enable_role then\n    update ${prefix}admin_roles set active = true, revoked_at = null, created_by_user_id = actor_id, created_at = now()\n    where user_id = target_user_id and role = target_role and not active;\n    if not found then\n      insert into ${prefix}admin_roles (user_id, role, created_by_user_id)\n      values (target_user_id, target_role, actor_id)\n      on conflict do nothing;\n    end if;\n  else`;
  const newRoleBlock = `  if enable_role then\n    insert into ${prefix}admin_roles (user_id, role, active, created_by_user_id, created_at, revoked_at)\n    values (target_user_id, target_role, true, actor_id, now(), null)\n    on conflict (user_id, role) do update set\n      active = true, created_by_user_id = excluded.created_by_user_id,\n      created_at = excluded.created_at, revoked_at = null;\n  else`;
  if (!sql.includes(oldRoleBlock)) throw new Error(`role block missing: ${file}`);
  fs.writeFileSync(file, sql.replace(oldRoleBlock, newRoleBlock));
}
